method: manually initialized template tracking + constrained LSD side-edge detection
assumptions: fixed camera and fixed lower body; local translation compensates small accidental movement

config.note: Manual first-frame ROI initialization for this video; coordinates must be changed for other scenes. Angles are uncalibrated image projection angles.

timestamp_method: frame_index / nominal FPS; assumes constant frame rate
angle_type: uncalibrated 2D projection; no mechanical-angle ground truth
smoothing: causal median of up to 5 consecutive valid frames; resets after every invalid frame
support_score_type: heuristic image support; not probability or validated accuracy
